collection.selection: Most-viewed free templates in the AI category containing the AI Agent node; deterministic ties by template ID.

manualReviewQueue.policy: Critical findings and high-severity AA-003, AA-004 or AA-007 path findings require template-level validation.

signals.title: No rate or cost boundary was detected before model usage
Untrusted input can reach a model without a visible validation boundary
A model can reach an external write action without an approval step
Review HTTP request URLs derived from workflow data
Outbound requests do not show an explicit timeout or retry policy
No structured model-output validation was detected
External actions have no visible audit record
Public webhook authentication is not enforced by the trigger
A credential reference is shared across untrusted and approved lanes
No workflow-level failure route was detected

limitations: These are heuristic static-analysis signals, not confirmed vulnerabilities.
No community workflow was imported, activated or executed.
Public exports cannot prove runtime authorization, credential scopes, upstream controls or model behavior.
Critical findings and high-severity path findings require manual validation before publication.
AA-006 remains an aggregate scanner signal, but it is not a template-level publication target because exports cannot reveal instance-level rate or cost controls.
AA-011 compares credential references within one export; it cannot prove real credential scopes or correlate credentials hidden across separate workflows.
The sample represents the most-viewed free AI Agent templates returned by the official API at collection time, not the entire template library.
